name: Kiboar
description: Keyboard components for KiCad: controller boards, encoders, connectors, displays and more.
description_full:
Kiboar is a keyboard-component library for KiCad 10: 145 symbols, 175 footprints and 130 3D models, split into 20 footprint libraries.

The bulk of the content is original work under the MIT licence. All 130 models and 130 of the 145 symbols are original, and carry the author and the licence inside the file: the STEP FILE_NAME header and two hidden symbol properties. Fifteen symbols are third-party imports that keep their own licence: ten from SnapEDA and five from Component Search Engine, both CC BY-SA 4.0 with the Design Exception, so they need attribution when the files themselves are redistributed. No model or footprint carries a non-commercial or NoDerivatives licence. Keyswitch footprints and models are being redesigned and are not part of this version. See the NOTICE file in the source repository for the per-origin list, the evidence and the required attribution before you redistribute the collection.
